title: SWF: ActionScript DoAction tag encoding
description: Unit test that AS2 scripts attached to frame keyframes are correctly compiled into DoAction (tag 12) in the SWF output. Create a FlashDocument with a frame that has a script (e.g. 'trace("hello");'), export to SWF, parse the binary to locate a DoAction tag (type 12), verify it contains non-empty ActionScript bytecode (at minimum an ActionEnd 0x00 byte). Tests in packages/swf/src/__tests__/doaction.test.ts.
